0425c8df31d0ba43e6b34cead18ad02f0cf7de56.summary: Malpedia index entry for the StoneDrill Windows malware family, maintained by Fraunhofer FKIE. It lists Charming Kitten as the associated actor and gives reference titles from Kaspersky, Symantec, PWC UK and CrowdStrike published 2017 to 2022. The page has no description of its own, so it is a list of references rather than a threat report.

audit_history.note: countries[0]: The quote is the title of a Symantec report about Elfin that merely lists StoneDrill among its entries. The page does not say StoneDrill targets S
